name: 98422 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98422 (Tacoma) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98422 (Tacoma) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98422 (Tacoma) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
